2026_05_DET_ARI.headline: Hutchinson targets Arizona’s rookie tackle as Lions seek defensive response
2026_05_DET_ARI.paragraph1: Detroit needs a cleaner defensive performance after allowing Carolina to score freely, while Jared Goff has continued producing yardage through the air. Arizona is replacing injured left tackle Paris Johnson Jr. with rookie Jayden Williams, creating a difficult matchup against Aidan Hutchinson. The Cardinals also expect to sit Marvin Harrison Jr. amid trade discussions, putting more receiving responsibility on Trey McBride and Michael Wilson. Detroit must turn pressure into disrupted drives without surrendering easy throws; Arizona needs Jacoby Brissett to release the ball quickly and avoid giveaways.
2026_05_DET_ARI.model_rationale: Detroit can pressure Arizona’s altered offensive line, but must finish tackles and protect against quick passes. The Cardinals need efficient distribution and reliable protection to sustain drives.
